## How to use a prompt

1. Open a prompt file and copy the block under **Prompt**.
2. Paste it into the model the video was made with (shown on the entry) — for code-rendered videos, ask for the result as a single HTML file.
3. Record the page if you want a video.

Some creators shared only part of their prompt, or only described the result in their post; those files say so.
